UNSAFE_style.description:
**Use at your own risk:** Custom style for specific elements. This should only be used as a
**last resort**. Using this may result in unexpected side effects.
More information in the [Customizing components Guide](https://atlantis.getjobber.com/guides/customizing-components).

accessibilityHint.description: Accessibility hint to help users understand what will happen when they press the button

accessibilityLabel.description:
Accessibility label for the component. This is required for components that
have an `icon` but not a `label`.

If the string is the same as the `label` prop, you don't need to add an
`accessibilityLabel`. **Don't use this for testing purposes.**

fullHeight.description: Will make the button scale to take up all the available height

fullWidth.description: Will make the button scale to take up all of the available width

icon.description: Adds an leading icon beside the label.

label.description: Text to be displayed on the button

loading.description: Changes the button interface to imply loading and prevents the press callback

size.description: Defines the size of the button

testID.description: Used to locate this view in end-to-end tests.

variation.description: Themes the button to the type of action it performs
